question: Who was recognised for his services in the discovery of inert gaseous elements in air and in the determination of their place in the periodic system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir William Ramsay**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sir William Ramsay** was recognized for his services in the discovery of inert gaseous elements in air.
 
• He played a crucial role in the determination of their place in the periodic system.
 
• Ramsay's work led to the identification of the noble gases, including helium, neon, argon, krypton, and xenon.
 
• His contributions significantly advanced the field of chemistry and our understanding of the periodic table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sir William Ramsay** was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1904 for his discovery of the noble gases.
 
• He collaborated with Lord Rayleigh in the discovery of argon, which led to further discoveries in the noble gas group.
 
• Ramsay's work provided critical insights into the development of the modern periodic table.
 
• His achievements have had a lasting impact on both theoretical and practical chemistry.
